title: Transformable Items
description: Lets you move and resize held items, with the additional option of disabling Item Height Animations(Held item moving up and down when switching items or attacking)
body: # Distribution Warning This and the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/shaweel/transformableitems) are the two **ONLY OFFICIAL SOURCES**. There will never be an official CurseForge page for the mod, because of how painful their user interface is to use and me personally not liking Overwolf as a company. Even though the license I use—the MIT License allows redistribution, I strongly advise you to only download Transformable Items from these two sources. If you do decide to download it through a different source, be extra careful and check the code to make sure it doesn't contain malware even on sites which review uploaded mods like CurseForge. # Transformable Items Lets you move and resize held items, with the additional option of disabling Item Height Animations(Held item moving up and down when switching items or attacking) ## Version Support I plan to support Fabric 1.14.1-latest, Forge 1.6.4-latest and NeoForge 1.20.1-latest. I might also implement Forge 1.5.2 depending on how hard setting up Mixin would be. Currently, Transformable Items is stable on Fabric and Quilt 1.14.1-26.2, Forge 1.12-26.2 and NeoForge 1.20.1-26.2. ## Installation 1. Install your mod loader of choice 2. Download the mod for your Minecraft version and mod loader of choice 3. Move it into your `.minecraft/mods` directory. 4. Launch the game ## Configuration You can open the user-friendly custom made configuration by either opening it via Mod Menu(or the built in mod list when using Forge) or using the keybind(F7 by default, configured in Controls) ## Screenshots
